// ===== 05_standalone/balloon_fight/balloonz__000__33_37.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: balloon fight/balloonz.nw
// npc-index: 0
// header: NPC - 33 37
// image: -
// tile: 33,37
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: 3ff1ca9ebd5d

NPC - 33 37
// NPC made by Onijustin and Kondie and Tricxta :o
if(playerenters){
  addtiledef2 vinland_bf-tiles.gif,balloonz,1440,80;
  play Balloon_Fight_2.mid;
  disabledefmovement;
  timereverywhere;
  playerdir=3;
  setstring xvecmax,6;
  setstring xgrmax,3;
  setstring xvec,0;
  setstring dir,3;
  setplayerprop #P5,2;
  this.hurttiles={0xA9A};
  timeout=0.05;
}
if(timeout){
  playerhearts=playerfullhearts;

  setstring yvec,#v(strtofloat(#s(yvec))+.05);

  triggeraction playerx+1.5,playery+4,Pop,;
  triggeraction playerx+1.5+vecx(playerdir),playery+4,Pop,;
  showimg 70,block.png,playerx+.5,playery+4;

  if(keydown(1)){
    playerdir = 1;
    if (!onwall(playerx-1,playery)){
      playerx -= .05;
    }
  }
  if(keydown(3)){
    playerdir = 3;
    if (!onwall(playerx+2.5,playery)){
      playerx +=.05;
    }
  }
  if (keydown(5)){
    if (!onwall(playerx+.5,playery)){
      playery -= .05;
    }
  }
  if((onwall(playerx+1.5,playery+3)||onwall(playerx+0.5,playery+3)||onwall(playerx+1.5,playery+3))&&strtofloat(#s(yvec))=>0){

    setstring yvec,0;

    playery=int(playery);

    if(keydown(1)){
      if(pumping=0){
        if(strtofloat(#s(dir))==1){

          setstring xvec,#v(strtofloat(#s(xvec))+2);
        }else{
          setstring xvec,#v(strtofloat(#s(xvec))-2);
        }
        if(strtofloat(#s(xvec))=<0){setstring dir,1;}
      }
    }

    if(keydown(3)){
      if(pumping=0){
        if(strtofloat(#s(dir))==3){

          setstring xvec,#v(strtofloat(#s(xvec))+0.5);
        }else{
          setstring xvec,#v(strtofloat(#s(xvec))-0.5);
        }
        if(strtofloat(#s(xvec))=<0){setstring dir,3;}
      }
    }


    if(!keydown(3)&&!keydown(1)){
      if(strtofloat(#s(xvec))>0){
        setstring xvec,#v(strtofloat(#s(xvec))-0.25);
      }
    }

    if(keydown(6)&&playerflap==0){
      setani idle,;
      setstring yvec,#v(strtofloat(#s(yvec))-2);
      playerflap=1;
    }

    if(strtofloat(#s(xvec))>strtofloat(#s(xgrmax)))setstring xvec,#v(strtofloat(#s(xgrmax)));
  }

  if(keydown(6)&&playerflap=0){

    if(keydown(1)){

      if(strtofloat(#s(dir))==1){

        setstring xvec,#v(strtofloat(#s(xvec))+0.5);
      }else{
        setstring xvec,#v(strtofloat(#s(xvec))-0.5);
      }
      if(strtofloat(#s(xvec))=<0){setstring dir,1;}
    }

    if(keydown(3)){

      if(strtofloat(#s(dir))==3){

        setstring xvec,#v(strtofloat(#s(xvec))+0.5);
      }else{
        setstring xvec,#v(strtofloat(#s(xvec))-0.5);
      }
      if(strtofloat(#s(xvec))=<0){setstring dir,3;}
    }

    setstring yvec,#v(strtofloat(#s(yvec))-0.30);
    playerflap=1;

    if(strtofloat(#s(xvec))>strtofloat(#s(xvecmax)))setstring xvec,#v(strtofloat(#s(xvecmax)));
  }

  if(!keydown(6)){playerflap=0;}

  for(i=0.5;i<2.5;i++){
    if(onwall(playerx+i,playery-2)){setstring yvec,0.9;}
  }

  for(i=-2;i<2;i++){
    if(onwall(playerx+0.5,playery+i)){setstring dir,3;}
    if(onwall(playerx+2.5,playery+i)){setstring dir,1;}
  }
  if(strtofloat(#s(xvec))<0)setstring xvec,0;

  playery+=strtofloat(#s(yvec))/16*3;
  if(strtofloat(#s(dir))==3){
    playerx+=strtofloat(#s(xvec))/16*3;
  }else{
    playerx-=strtofloat(#s(xvec))/16*3;}

  while (onwall(playerx+1.5,playery+2.5))playery-=1/16;//debug so player never gets caught on a wall

  if (strtofloat(#P5)<=0)Gameover();

  if (tiles[playerx+1.5,playery+2] in this.hurttiles)triggeraction playerx+1.5,playery+2,Pop,;

  if (playerx>61)playerx=(playerx+4)%64;
  else if (playerx<1)playerx=(playerx-4+64)%64;

  draw_Balloons();

  timeout = 0.05;
}

function draw_Balloons(){
  hideimgs 300,300+(playerscount*20);
  for (this.pl=0;this.pl<playerscount;this.pl++){
    for (this.i=0;this.i<strtofloat(#P5(this.pl));this.i++){
      this.placex=players[this.pl].x+1.2-(strtofloat(#P5(this.pl))/2)+this.i;
      showimg 300+(this.pl*20)+this.i,balloon1.gif,this.placex,players[this.pl].y-2.5;
      changeimgpart 300+(this.pl*20)+this.i,1,1,24,29;
      showpoly 300+(this.pl*20)+10+this.i,{this.placex+.75,players[this.pl].y-.7,players[this.pl].x+1.45,players[this.pl].y};
    }
  }
}

function Gameover(){
  setplayerprop #c,oh shit!;
  sleep 1;
  while (!onwall(playerx+1.5,playery+3)){
    for (this.i=0;this.i<2;this.i+=1/16){
      if (!onwall(playerx+1.5,playery+3))playery+=1/16;
      else break;
    }
    sleep .05;
  }
  setani dead,;
  showpoly 300,{0,0,screenwidth,0,screenwidth,screenheight,0,screenheight};
  changeimgvis 300,4;
  changeimgcolors 300,0,0,0,0;
  showtext 301,screenwidth/2,screenheight/2,arial,c,Game over loser!;
  changeimgvis 301,5;
  for (this.i=3;this.i>0;this.i--){
    showtext 302,screenwidth/2,screenheight/2+50,arial,c,Respawning in:#v(this.i);
    changeimgvis 302,5;
    changeimgzoom 302,.7;
    sleep 1;
  }
  hideimgs 300,302;
  callnpc 0,Playerenters,;
  setplayerprop #P5,2;
  timeout=0.05;
}

NPCEND

// ===== 05_standalone/balloon_fight/balloonz__004__33_31.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: balloon fight/balloonz.nw
// npc-index: 4
// header: NPC - 33 31
// image: -
// tile: 33,31
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: 32da358bd5fb

NPC - 33 31
// NPC made by tricxta
if (playerenters){
  timereverywhere;
  setcharprop #P1,vinland_bf-birdsprites.gif;
  setcharprop #P2,1;
  setcharani vinland_bf-bird_fly,;
  this.blocktiles={0xA8A,0xA9A};//blocking non-blocking tiles :o
  this.speed=.4;
  timeout=0.05;
}

if (timeout){
  draw_Balloons();
  if (this.cooldown>0)this.cooldown-=1;
  if (isleader){
    if (strtofloat(#P2(-1))<=0)fall();
    if (this.move<=0){
      this.move=int(random(0,10));
      this.angle=random(0,pi*2);
      dir=(this.angle>pi/2 && this.angle<(pi*1.5))?1:3;
    }
    else {
      this.checkx=x+cos(this.angle)*this.speed;
      this.checky=y+sin(this.angle)*this.speed;
      if (!onwall(this.checkx+1.5,this.checky+1) && !tiles[this.checkx,this.checky] == 0xA9A){
        x=this.checkx;
        y=this.checky;
        this.move-=this.speed;
      }
      else this.move=0;
    }
  }
  else if (strtofloat(#P2(-1))<=0)break;
  timeout=0.05;
}

if (actionPop){
  if (this.cooldown<=0){
    if (strtofloat(#P2(-1))==-1)points();
    else {
      setcharprop #P2,#v(strtofloat(#P2(-1))-1);
      this.cooldown=1;
    }
  }
  timeout=0.05;
}

function draw_Balloons(){
  hideimgs 300,340;
  for (this.i=0;this.i<strtofloat(#P2(-1));this.i++){
    this.placex=x+1.2-(strtofloat(#P2(-1))/2)+this.i;
    showimg 300++this.i,balloon2.gif,this.placex,y-2.5;
    changeimgpart 300+this.i,1,1,24,29;
    showpoly 320+10+this.i,{this.placex+.75,y-.7,x+1.45,y+.5};
  }
}

function fall(){
  while (!onwall(x+1,y+3)){
    hideimgs 300,340;
    y+=1;
    if (tiles[x+1,y+2] in this.blocktiles)points();
    sleep .05;
  }
  setcharprop #P2,-1;
}

function points(){
  //will put point shit here eventually...
  hide;
  break;
}

if (playerchats && strequals(#c,/drop))fall();

NPCEND

// ===== 05_standalone/farm_server/planting__000__37_36.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: farm server/planting.nw
// npc-index: 0
// header: NPC - 37 36
// image: -
// tile: 37,36
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: d88ac1306fd2

NPC - 37 36
// NPC made by tricxta
if (playerenters){
  timereverywhere;
  pi=3.142857142857143;
  this.farmtiles={0xAA};

  setstring this.stateTool,Hoe,"Watering Bucket";
  timeout=0.05;
}

if (timeout){
  this.checkx=int(mousex/2)*2;
  this.checky=int(mousey/2)*2;
  this.distx=(this.checkx-(int((playerx+.5)/2)*2))/2;
  this.disty=(this.checky-(int((playery+1)/2)*2))/2;
  this.dist=abs(this.distx)+abs(this.disty);
  if (this.dist==1)check();
  else hideimgs 300,303;
  timeout=0.05;
}

if (mousedown && this.dist==1 && playerfreezetime<=-1){
  check();
  if (this.check==0){
    playerdir=(((getangle(this.distx,this.disty)*(180/pi))/90)+3)%4;
    callweapon selectedweapon,weaponfired;
  }
}

function check(){
  hideimgs 300,303;
  this.check=0;
  for (this.i=0;this.i<4;this.i++){
    showimg 300+this.i,farm-shit_place.png,this.checkx+(this.i%2),this.checky+int(this.i/2);
     this.tNpc = testnpc(this.checkx+(this.i%2),this.checky+int(this.i/2));

    this.canFarm = (tiles[this.checkx+(this.i%2),this.checky+int(this.i/2)] in this.farmtiles && npcs[this.tNpc].save[3] == lindexof(#w(selectedweapon),this.stateTool));

    changeimgpart 300+this.i,(1-this.canFarm)*16,0,16,16;
    changeimgmode 300+this.i,1;
    if (lighteffectsenabled)changeimgcolors 300+this.i,1,1,1,.5;
    changeimgvis 300+this.i,2;

    if (this.canFarm == 0)this.check = 1;
  }
}

// ===== 05_standalone/farm_server/planting__001__52_30.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: farm server/planting.nw
// npc-index: 1
// header: NPC - 52 30
// image: -
// tile: 52,30
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: b32850e6858d

NPC - 52 30
if(playerenters) {
  toweapons MovementSys;
  this.jumptile = {4060,4062,4063}; // Some Cliff Tiles
  this.field = {420,421,436,437}; // Swamp Tiles
  this.PC_Step = 5; // How long (x 0.05sec) it takes to move.
  setarray this.key,10;
  PC_Snap(); // Snap to Grid
  timeout = 0.05;
}

if(playerchats) freezeplayer 3;

if (timeout && isweapon) {
  disabledefmovement;
  GrabKeys();
  //if(playerfreezetime > -1) setplayerprop #c,#v(playerfreezetime);
  //Movement
  if(this.moving == -1 && this.Sou_bump > 0) this.Sou_bump = 0;
  if(playerfreezetime < 0 && !this.moving < 0) PC_Move();
  else if(this.moving < 0) if(strequals(#m,walk) || strequals(#m,ride)) setani idle,;

  timeout = 0.05;
}

//Grab Key Status
function GrabKeys() {
  this.moving = -1; // Moving Reset
  this.move_h = 0;
  for(this.ktest=0; this.ktest<10; this.ktest++) {
    if(keydown(this.ktest)) {
      if(this.ktest<4) this.moving = this.ktest; // Moving in this Direction
      if(this.key[this.ktest] < 1) {
        this.key[this.ktest] = 1; // Pressed
      } else {
        this.key[this.ktest] = 2; // Held
        if(this.moving < 4) this.move_h = 1;
      }
    } else {
      if(this.key[this.ktest] > 0) {
        this.key[this.ktest] = -1; // Unpressed
      } else {
        this.key[this.ktest] = 0; // Unheld
      }
    }
  }
}


//Snap to Grid (2x2)
function PC_Snap() {
  playerx = int((playerx + 0.5) / 2)*2 - 0.5;
  playery = int((playery + 1.5) / 2)*2 - 1;
}


//MovementSys
function PC_Move() {
  if(this.key[5] < 1 && (strequals(#m,idle) || strequals(#m,ride))) setani walk,; //Walk ani
  if(this.key[5] > 0 && (strequals(#m,idle) || strequals(#m,walk))) setani ride,; //Run ani

  if(playerdir == this.moving) this.move_h = 1;
  else {playerdir = this.moving % 4; this.Sou_bump = 0; } // Turning

  if(this.canwalk > 0 || this.move_h == 0) Ran_Encounter(); // Random Encounter

  if(this.move_h == 1) { // Direction Key is Held, Lets Try Moving
    if(this.key[5] > 0) { this.PC_Step = 3; // [S] key, Held or Pressed
    } else { this.PC_Step = 5; }// [S] key, Released or Unheld

    for(this.i=0;this.i<4;this.i++){
      if(onwall(playerx+0.5+vecx(playerdir)*2+this.i%2,playery+1+vecy(playerdir)*2+int(this.i/2))) this.i=4;
      if(playerdir == 2 && tiles[playerx+0.5+vecx(playerdir)*2+this.i%2,playery+1+vecy(playerdir)*2+1] in this.jumptile) this.i=6;
    }
    this.canwalk = abs(this.i - 5);

    // if ( this.canwalk > 0 ) { } , insert "steps" shit around here (eg: Repel & Pedometer)

    if(this.canwalk == 1) { // Can walk.
      if(this.PC_Step < 1) this.PC_Step = 1;
      for(this.i = 0; this.i < this.PC_Step; this.i++) {
        playerx += vecx(playerdir) * (2/this.PC_Step);
        playery += vecy(playerdir) * (2/this.PC_Step);
        if(this.i + 1 < this.PC_Step) sleep 0.05;
      }
      PC_Snap(); //Finished Moving, Snap to Grid
    } else if(this.canwalk == 2 && playerdir == 2) { // Jumping
      freezeplayer 0.3;
      setani walk,;
      sleep 0.1;
      play jump.wav;
      setani sit,;
      for(this.i = 0; this.i < 6; this.i++) {
        playery += vecy(2) * 2/3;
        if(this.i + 1 < this.PC_Step) sleep 0.05;
      }
      setani idle,;
      PC_Snap(); //Finished Moving, Snap to Grid
    } else { // Path is Blocked
      if(strequals(#m,walk) || strequals(#m,ride)) setani idle,;
      if(this.Sou_bump == 0) play put.wav;
      this.Sou_bump = (this.Sou_bump+0.05) % 0.6;
    }
  } else sleep 0.05;
}


//Wild Pokemon
function Ran_Encounter() {
  setplayerprop #c,;
  if(tiles[playerx+0.5,playery+1] in this.field) { // Encounter System
    for(this.m=0; this.m < int(arraylen(PC_Encounter)/3); this.m++) {
      if(PC_Encounter[this.m*3+2] > random(0,100)) { // Random Chance
        this.move_h = 0; // Turn off Walking
        for(this.i=0;this.i<weaponscount;this.i++) {
          if(strequals(#w(this.i),BattleSys)) //Find "BattleSys" to Trigger
            callweapon this.i,Battle,wild,#v(PC_Encounter[this.m*3]),#v(PC_Encounter[this.m*3+1]),#v(PC_Encounter[this.m*3+2]); //index,Battle,"type","monID","monLv","Chance?";
        }
        break;
      }
    }
  }
}

NPCEND

// ===== 05_standalone/farm_server/planting__002__48_18.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: farm server/planting.nw
// npc-index: 2
// header: NPC xialza_water-bucket-icon.png 48 18
// image: xialza_water-bucket-icon.png
// tile: 48,18
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: af131da3c860

NPC xialza_water-bucket-icon.png 48 18
if (playerenters && !isweapon){toweapons Watering Bucket;}
if (weaponfired){
  triggeraction playerx+1.5+vecx(playerdir)*2,playery+2+vecy(playerdir)*2,Water,;
  triggeraction playerx+1.5+vecx(playerdir)*2,playery+1.5+vecy(playerdir)*2,Water,;
  setani xialza_pour-water,;
  freezeplayer 1.5;
  sleep 1.5;
  setani idle,;
}

if (getdescription)setstring client.description,Watering Bucket:You can use this to wet plowed plant patches.;

// ===== 05_standalone/iControl/icontrol__000__29_27.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: iControl/icontrol.nw
// npc-index: 0
// header: NPC - 29 27
// image: -
// tile: 29,27
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: 96f288965852

NPC - 29 27
if (playerenters) {
  playery=y;
  if (!isweapon) toweapons iMove;
  this.pcrds = {10,(screenheight-120),(screenwidth-50),(screenheight/2)};
  this.bw = 40;
  this.bh = 40;

  for (this.i=0;this.i<weaponscount;this.i++){//fetch the weapon index
    if (strequals(#w(this.i),iMove)){
      this.index=this.i;
      break;
    }
  }

  this.speed = 0.5;//player movement speed
  drawgui();
}

function drawgui() {
  this.drawx = this.pcrds[0]+40;
  this.drawy = this.pcrds[1]+40;
  for (this.i=0;this.i<4;this.i++) {
    showimg 300+this.i,classiciphone_virtualkey#v(this.i)_blue.png,this.drawx+vecx(this.i)*this.bw,this.drawy+vecy(this.i)*this.bh;
    changeimgzoom 300+this.i,1;
    changeimgvis 300+this.i,4;
  }
  showimg 304,classiciphone_virtualkey_sword_blue.png,this.pcrds[2],this.pcrds[3];
  changeimgzoom 304,1;
  changeimgvis 304,4;
}

if (mousedown && isweapon) {
  if (mousescreenx in |this.pcrds[0],this.pcrds[0]+(this.bw*3)| && mousescreeny in |this.pcrds[1],this.pcrds[1]+(this.bh*3)|) {
    this.drawx = this.pcrds[0]+40;
    this.drawy = this.pcrds[1]+40;
    for (this.i=0;this.i<4;this.i++) {
      while (leftmousebutton && mousescreenx in |this.drawx+vecx(this.i)*this.bw,this.drawx+vecx(this.i)*this.bw+this.bw| && mousescreeny in |this.drawy+vecy(this.i)*this.bh,this.drawy+vecy(this.i)*this.bh+this.bh|) {
        changeimgzoom 300+this.i,1.5;
        callweapon this.index,move,#v(this.i);
        sleep .05;
      }
    }
  }
  else if (mousescreenx in |this.pcrds[2],this.pcrds[2]+this.bw| && mousescreeny in |this.pcrds[3],this.pcrds[3]+this.bh|) {
    changeimgzoom 304,1.5;
    callweapon this.index,sword,;
    while (leftmousebutton) sleep 0.05;//no easy sword spamming
  }
  drawgui();
}

if (move){
  setplayerprop #c,#v(strtofloat(#p(0)));
  this.j=strtofloat(#p(0));
  if (!onwall(playerx+1.5+vecx(this.j),playery+2+vecy(this.j))){
    playerdir=this.j;
    setani walk,;
    playerx+=vecx(this.j)*this.speed;
    playery+=vecy(this.j)*this.speed;
  }
}

if (sword) {
  freezeplayer 1;
  setani sword,;
}

// ===== 05_standalone/parallax_scrolling/ssa_scroller__001__12_13.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: parallax scrolling/ssa_scroller.nw
// npc-index: 1
// header: NPC - 12 13
// image: -
// tile: 12,13
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: 9bbb4786b885

NPC - 12 13
//Made by tricxta
if (playerenters){
  if (level.islobby == 1)break;
  if (!isweapon)toweapons -movement;
  disabledefmovement;
  this.player.speed = .75;
  this.player.offsetX = 1.5;
  this.player.offsetY = 3;
  this.player.orgFallSpeed = 1;
  this.player.FallSpeed = this.player.orgFallSpeed;
  this.player.FallAdd = 0.05;
  this.player.maxFallSpeed = 2.5;
  this.player.normalJumpHeight=10;
  this.climbTiles = {0x486,0x487,0x496,0x497};
  this.keysDown = {0,0,0,0,0,0,0};//1 held, else 0

  setstring this.Ganis,idle,walk,ssa_climbidle,ssa_climb;
  timeout=0.05;
}

if (isweapon && timeout){
  if (!movementdisabled){
    this.canClimb = (tiles[playerx+this.player.offsetX,playery+1] in this.climbTiles);

    this.keyPressed = 0;
    this.check = 0;

    for (this.i=0;this.i<4;this.i++){
      if (keydown(this.i)){
        this.key = this.i;
        this.keyPressed = 1;

        if ((this.i+1)%2==0){//horizontal movement
          playerdir = this.i;
          this.gani = 1;
          for (this.j=0;this.j<this.player.speed;this.j+=1/16){
            this.checkX = playerx+1.5+vecx(this.i)*17/16;
            if (onwall(this.checkX,playery+1)){playertouchsme();break;}
            if (onwall(this.checkX,playery+2) && !this.fall==0)break;
            playerx+=vecx(this.i)*1/16;
          }
        }
        else {//vertical movement
          if (this.canClimb == 1){//Climbing the vine
            this.gani = 3;
            this.check = (this.i == 0 && !onwall(playerx+this.player.offsetX,playery) && tiles[playerx+this.player.offsetX,playery] in this.climbTiles);
            this.divis = (this.i==0)?2:1;
            if (this.i == 2 || this.check == 1)playery+= vecy(this.i)*this.player.speed/this.divis;
          }
          else if (this.keysDown[0] == 0){
            this.keysDown[0] = 1;
            triggeraction playerx+this.player.offsetX,playery+2,Interface,#a;//Npc interaction
          }
        }
      }
    }

    //Gani set
    if (this.canClimb == 1)playerdir = 0;

    if (this.keyPressed == 0)this.gani = (this.canClimb == 1)?2:0;

    if (!strequals(#m,#I(this.Ganis,this.gani)))setani #I(this.Ganis,this.gani),;
    //--------------------------------------

    //Jump trigger
    if (keydown(6) && this.jump==0 && onwall(playerx+this.player.offsetX,playery+this.player.offsetY+1/16) && !onwall(playerx+this.player.offsetX,playery) && this.keysDown[6] == 0){
      play jump.wav;
      this.keysDown[6] = 1;
      this.jump=1;
      this.jumpHeight = this.player.normalJumpHeight;
      this.player.FallSpeed = this.player.orgFallSpeed;
    }

    //Key handler
    for (this.i=0;this.i<7;this.i++){
      if (!keydown(this.i))this.keysDown[this.i] = 0;
    }

    checkHeadOnwall();//Check if the head is onwall
    if (this.jump>0 && this.jump<this.jumpHeight && this.how == 0){this.jump++;playery-=(this.jumpHeight-this.jump)*.2;}
    else if (this.jump>0 || this.how>0){
      this.jump=-1;
      if (this.how>0){
        for (this.i=0;this.i<npcscount;this.i++){
          if (playerx+1.5 in |npcs[this.i].x,npcs[this.i].x+npcs[this.i].width| && playery in |npcs[this.i].y,npcs[this.i].y+npcs[this.i].height|)callnpc this.i,playerhitbottom,#v(playerdir);
        }
      }
    }

    if (!onwall(playerx+this.player.offsetX,playery+this.player.offsetY-1/16) && this.jump<=0 && this.canClimb == 0){
      this.i=1/16;
      while (!onwall(playerx+this.player.offsetX,playery+this.player.offsetY+this.i))this.i+=1/16;
      if (this.i<2)playery+=this.i;
      else {
        playery+=this.player.FallSpeed;
        if (this.player.FallSpeed < this.player.maxFallSpeed)this.player.FallSpeed += this.player.FallAdd;
      }
    }
    if (onwall(playerx+this.player.offsetX,playery+this.player.offsetY)){
      this.jump=0;
      for (this.i=0;this.i<npcscount;this.i++){
        if (playerx+1.5 in |npcs[this.i].x,npcs[this.i].x+npcs[this.i].width| && playery+3.5 in |npcs[this.i].y,npcs[this.i].y+npcs[this.i].height|)callnpc this.i,playerontop,#v(playerdir);
      }
      while (onwall(playerx+this.player.offsetX,playery+this.player.offsetY))playery-=1/16;
    }
  }
  timeout=0.05;
}

function checkHeadOnwall(){
  this.how = 0;
  for (this.k=0;this.k<2;this.k++)this.how+=(onwall(playerx+0.5+this.k,playery-.5));
}

function playertouchsme(){
  for (this.i=0;this.i<npcscount;this.i++){
    if (playerx+vecx(playerdir)*2 in |npcs[this.i].x,npcs[this.i].x+npcs[this.i].width|)callnpc this.i,playertouchsme,#v(playerdir);
  }
}

if (actionBounce){
  this.jump = 1;
  play jump.wav;
  this.jumpHeight = strtofloat(#p(0));
  this.player.FallSpeed = this.player.orgFallSpeed;
}

NPCEND

// ===== 05_standalone/parallax_scrolling/ssa_scroller__002__36_39.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: parallax scrolling/ssa_scroller.nw
// npc-index: 2
// header: NPC - 36 39
// image: -
// tile: 36,39
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: 5eda5dc6b2e0

NPC - 36 39
// NPC made by tricxta
if (playerenters){
  if (isweapon){
    showstats 1024;
    setstring this.backGround,Sky_back_layer.gif,6,dsa.gif,12;

    this.drawC = {screenwidth/2-320,screenheight/2-240};
    setstring this.tileset,ssa_game-tiles.gif;
    this.transparentTiles = {0x0,0x400,0x410};
    this.groundTile = 0x554;//in the case the tile trying to be draw doesn't have any data use this tile
    this.liquidTiles = {0x440,0x450};
    this.sSize = {40,30};//tile sample size:width,height
    this.drawC = {screenwidth/2-320,screenheight/2-240};

    showpoly 299,{0,0,screenwidth,0,screenwidth,screenheight,0,screenheight};
    changeimgcolors 299,,,,;
    changeimgvis 299,4;

    timeout=0.05;
  }
  else toweapons parallaxHandler;
}

if (timeout && isweapon){
  this.pC = {playerx-(this.sSize[0]/2),int(playery-this.sSize[1]/1.5)};
  this.plOS = {(playerx-int(playerx))*16,(playery-int(playery))*16};//player rounded values offset

  showtext 298,10,10,arial,l,#v(int(playerx)),#v(int(playery)),#v(onmapx(#L)*64+playerx),#v(this.plOS[1]);
  changeimgvis 298,5;

  this.plC = {this.drawC[0]+(playerx-this.pC[0])*16 ,this.drawC[1]+(playery-this.pC[1])*16 + (16-this.plOS[1])};

  showani 300,this.plC[0],this.plC[1],playerdir,#m,;
  changeimgvis 300,11;


  drawBack();

  drawTiles();

  drawNpcs();

  if (this.chatTimer > 0){
    this.chatTimer -=0.05;
    if (this.chatTimer <= 0)hideimg 297;
    else {
      showtext 297,this.plC[0]+24,this.plC[1]-16,arial,c,#s(this.pChat);
      changeimgvis 297,11;
    }
  }
  timeout = 0.05;
}

function drawNpcs(){
  hideimgs 400,400+this.oldNCcount;
  this.oldNCcount = npcscount;
  for (this.i=0;this.i<npcscount;this.i++){
    this.nC = {npcs[this.i].x,npcs[this.i].y,npcs[this.i].width,npcs[this.i].height};
    if (!strequals(#f(this.i),) && (this.nC[0]+this.nC[2]/2) in |this.pC[0],this.pC[0]+this.sSize[0]| && (this.nC[1]+this.nC[3]/2) in |this.pC[1],this.pC[1]+this.sSize[1]|){
      showimg 400+this.i,#f(this.i),this.drawC[0]+(this.nC[0]-this.pC[0])*16+this.plOS[0],this.drawC[1]+(this.nC[1]-this.pC[1])*16;
      changeimgvis 400+this.i,npcs[this.i].save[0];
    }
    else hideimg 400+this.i;
  }
}

function drawTiles(){
  for (this.i=0;this.i< this.sSize[0] *  this.sSize[1];this.i++){
    this.tile = tiles[this.pC[0] + (this.i%this.sSize[0]),this.pC[1] +int(this.i/this.sSize[0])];
    if (this.tile in this.transparentTiles){
      hideimg 500+this.i;
    }
    else {
      if (this.tile == 32)this.tile = this.groundTile;//convert the invalid tile into a ground tile
      showimg 500+this.i,#s(this.tileset),this.drawC[0] + (this.i%this.sSize[0])*16,this.drawC[1] + int(this.i/this.sSize[0])*16;
      changeimgpart 500+this.i,256*int(this.tile/512)+16*(this.tile%16),int((this.tile%512)/16)*16,16,16;

      if (this.tile in this.liquidTiles){
        changeimgmode 500+this.i,1;
        changeimgcolors 500+this.i,1,1,1,0.5;
        changeimgvis 500+this.i,12;
      }
      else {
        changeimgvis 500+this.i,9;
        changeimgcolors 500+this.i,1,1,1,1;
      }
    }
  }
}

function drawBack(){
  for (this.i=0;this.i<sarraylen(this.backGround);this.i+=2){
    this.dist = strtofloat(#I(this.backGround,this.i+1));

    this.px = onmapx(#L)*64+playerx;

    showimg 301+this.i,#I(this.backGround,this.i),this.drawC[0]+640-(this.px*this.dist)%(this.sSize[0]*16),this.drawC[1];
    changeimgpart 301+this.i,0,480,(this.px*this.dist)%(this.sSize[0]*16),480;
    changeimgvis 301+this.i,5+(this.i/2);


    this.sX =(this.px*this.dist)%(this.sSize[0]*16);
    if (this.sX>=1){
      showimg 302+this.i,#I(this.backGround,this.i),this.drawC[0],this.drawC[1];
      changeimgpart 302+this.i,this.sX,480,640-this.sX,480;
      changeimgvis 302+this.i,5+(this.i/2);
    }
    else hideimg 302;
  }
}

if (playerchats){
  this.chatTimer = 5;
  setstring this.pChat,#c;
}

if (Playerenters){
  playerx = 0;
  playery = 0;
  disabledefmovement;
  setarray this.key,10;
  this.screenSize = {500,300};
  this.tl = {screenwidth/2-this.screenSize[0]/2,screenheight/2-this.screenSize[1]/2};
  setstring this.img,test_rpg.gif;
  setstring this.pointerImg,zold_icon_arrow_02.png;
  setstring this.commands,Attack,Escape,Item,Switch;
  setstring this.font,tempus sans ITC;
  this.currentHero = 0;

  this.bounds = {0,0,this.tl[0],0,this.tl[0],this.tl[1]+this.screenSize[1],this.tl[0]+this.screenSize[0],this.tl[1]+this.screenSize[1],this.tl[0]+this.screenSize[0],this.tl[1],this.tl[0],this.tl[1],this.tl[0],0,screenwidth,0,screenwidth,screenheight,0,screenheight};
  showpoly 299,this.bounds;
  changeimgcolors 299,,,,;
  changeimgvis 299,4;

  //intial focus handling
  this.originalFocus = {36,38};
  this.focus = {this.originalFocus[0],this.originalFocus[1],this.originalFocus[0],this.originalFocus[1]};//current 1,current 1,dest. x,dest. y
  setfocus this.focus[0],this.focus[1];
  //---------

  //Hero information, will be relocated in time
  setstring this.heroes,//name,head,class,id
    Barry,head0.png,warrior,1,
    John,head1.png,warrior,2,
    Kondie,head2.png,warrior,3;

  setstring this.userItems,
    Drugs,tricxta_mushroom.gif,"Receive a 10% strength boost to your current hero.",1,0,0,//name,icon,description,number of heroes affected,damage,special cost
    "Health Potion",tricxta_health-potion.gif,"Heals one hero for 1 hp.",1,0,0;

  setarray this.npcID,sarraylen(this.heroes)/4;
  this.npcID[0] = -1;

  setstring this.enemies,//enemy id's >= 50, (name,head,class,id)
    Noob1,head0.png,warrior,50,
    Noob1,head0.png,warrior,51;

  setarray this.enemyIDs,sarraylen(this.enemies)/4;

  //----------------------------
  drawCommands();

  timeout = 0.05;
}

if (timeout){
  if (this.npcID[0] == -1){//try again since no npcs were found
    getIDs();
    getEnemies();
    drawStats();
    enterHeroes();
  }
  get_Keys();

  for (this.i = 0; this.i < 4; this.i++){
    if (this.key[this.i] == 1 && this.i%2 == 0){
      play item2.wav;
      if (this.menuFocus == 0){//main menu
        this.commandSel = (this.commandSel+vecy(this.i))%4;
        drawCommands();
        drawStats();
      }
      else if (this.menuFocus == 1){//attack menu
        this.itemSel = max(0,min(sarraylen(this.items)/3-1,this.itemSel+vecy(this.i)));
        drawMenu();
      }
      else if (this.menuFocus == 2){//choose target
        this.targetSel = (this.targetSel+vecy(this.i))%(sarraylen(this.enemies)/4);
        this.focus[2] = npcs[this.enemyIDs[this.targetSel]].x;
        this.focus[3] = npcs[this.enemyIDs[this.targetSel]].y;
        shiftFocus();
        drawPointer();
      }
    }
  }

  if (this.key[5] == 1 && this.menuFocus >= 0){
    play sign.wav;
    if (this.menuFocus == 0){
      if (this.commandSel == 0){//open the attack menu
        this.menuFocus = 1;
        this.itemSel = 0;
        callnpc this.npcID[this.currentHero],getAttacks,;
      }
      else if (this.commandSel == 2){
        this.menuFocus = 1;
        this.itemSel = 0;
        setstring this.items,#s(this.userItems);
        drawMenu();
      }
      else if (this.commandSel == 3){
        this.currentHero = (this.currentHero+1)%(sarraylen(this.heroes)/4);
        enterHeroes();
      }
    }
    else if (this.menuFocus == 1){
      this.menuFocus = 0;
      hideimgs 350,400;
      if (this.commandSel == 2){

      }
      else if (this.commandSel == 0){
        this.menuFocus = 2;
        this.targetSel = 0;
        this.focus[2] = npcs[this.enemyIDs[this.targetSel]].x;
        this.focus[3] = npcs[this.enemyIDs[this.targetSel]].y;
        shiftFocus();

        drawPointer();
      }
    }
    else if (this.menuFocus == 2){
      if (this.commandSel == 0){
        callnpc this.npcID[this.currentHero],#I(this.items,this.itemSel*6),
          #v(npcs[this.enemyIDs[this.targetSel]].x+npcs[this.enemyIDs[this.targetSel]].width/2),
          #v(npcs[this.enemyIDs[this.targetSel]].y+npcs[this.enemyIDs[this.targetSel]].height/2),
          #I(this.items,this.itemSel*6+4);
        this.menuFocus = -1;//disable control
        hideimgs 350,400;
      }
    }
  }

  if (this.key[6] == 1 && this.menuFocus >= 0){
    revertControl();
  }

  timeout = 0.05;
}

function drawCommands(){
  for (this.i = 0; this.i < sarraylen(this.commands); this.i++){
    this.bInd = 300+this.i*3;
    showimg this.bInd,#s(this.img),this.tl[0],this.tl[1]+this.i*36;
    changeimgpart this.bInd,0,(this.i == this.commandSel)*38,92,36;
    changeimgvis this.bInd,4;

    showimg this.bInd+1,#s(this.img),this.tl[0]+5,this.tl[1]+11+this.i*36;
    changeimgpart this.bInd+1,1+this.i*16,79,14,14;
    changeimgvis this.bInd+1,5;

    showtext this.bInd+2,this.tl[0]+20,this.tl[1]+4+this.i*36,#s(this.font),lb,#I(this.commands,this.i);
    changeimgcolors this.bInd+2,203/255,172/255,65/255,;
    changeimgvis this.bInd+2,5;
  }
}

function drawStats(){
  for (this.i = 0; this.i < sarraylen(this.heroes)/4; this.i++){
    this.bInd = 320+this.i*6;
    this.drawX = this.tl[0]+this.screenSize[0]/2-(sarraylen(this.heroes)/8)*54 + this.i*54;
    showimg this.bInd,#s(this.img),this.drawX,this.tl[1];//main
    changeimgpart this.bInd,1,97,52,52;
    changeimgvis this.bInd,4;

    showimg this.bInd+1,#I(this.heroes,this.i*4+1),this.drawX+10,this.tl[1]+10;//head
    changeimgpart this.bInd+1,0,64,32,32;
    changeimgvis this.bInd+1,5;

    //health
    showimg this.bInd+2,#s(this.img),this.drawX+16,this.tl[1]+5;
    changeimgpart this.bInd+2,6,156,20,5;
    changeimgvis this.bInd+2,6;

    this.healthP = npcs[this.npcID[this.i]].hearts/npcs[this.npcID[this.i]].save[1];

    if (this.healthP > 0){
      showimg this.bInd+3,#s(this.img),this.drawX+16,this.tl[1]+5;
      changeimgpart this.bInd+3,6,163,this.healthP*20,5;
      changeimgvis this.bInd+3,7;
    }
    else hideimg this.bInd+3;

    //special
    showimg this.bInd+4,#s(this.img),this.drawX+16,this.tl[1]+38;
    changeimgpart this.bInd+4,6,156,20,5;
    changeimgvis this.bInd+4,6;

    this.specialP = npcs[this.npcID[this.i]].hearts/npcs[this.npcID[this.i]].save[1];

    if (this.specialP > 0){
      showimg this.bInd+5,#s(this.img),this.drawX+16,this.tl[1]+38;
      changeimgpart this.bInd+5,6,170,this.specialP*20,5;
      changeimgvis this.bInd+5,7;
    }
    else hideimg this.bInd+3;
  }
}

function drawMenu(){
  this.mC = {screenwidth/2-106,screenheight/2-98};
  showimg 350,#s(this.img),this.mC[0],this.mC[1];
  changeimgpart 350,93,0,217,200;

  for (this.item = 0; this.item < 5; this.item++){
    showimg 352+this.item*2,#I(this.items,this.item*6+1),this.mC[0]+5,this.mC[1]+4+this.item*32;
    showtext 353+this.item*2,this.mC[0]+40,this.mC[1]+10+this.item*32,#s(this.font),lb,#I(this.items,this.item*6);
    changeimgcolors 353+this.item*2,203/255,172/255,65/255,;
    if (this.item == this.itemSel){
      showimg 351,#s(this.img),this.mC[0]+5,this.mC[1]+4+this.item*32;
      changeimgpart 351,30,157,32,32;
    }
  }

  //draw description
  hideimgs 370,375;
  setstring this.text,#I(this.items,this.itemSel*6+2);
  if (this.commandSel == 0)//attack description
    setstring this.text,#s(this.text)Damage=#I(this.items,this.itemSel*6+4),Mana Cost=#I(this.items,this.itemSel*6+5);
  wraptext 40,,#s(this.text);
  for (this.d = 0; this.d < tokenscount;this.d++){
    showtext 364+this.d,this.mC[0]+8,this.mC[1]+154+this.d*10,#s(this.font),l,#t(this.d);
    changeimgcolors 364+this.d,203/255,172/255,65/255,;
    changeimgzoom 364+this.d,0.6;
  }

  for (this.v = 0; this.v < 14+this.d; this.v++)changeimgvis 350+this.v,(this.v==0)?5:6;
  changeimgvis 351,7;//cursor
}

function get_Keys(){
  this.moveKey = 0;
  for (this.keyCheck = 0;this.keyCheck < 10; this.keyCheck++){
    if (keydown(this.keyCheck))
      this.key[this.keyCheck] = (this.key[this.keyCheck] == 0)?1:2;//1 = pressed,2 = held
    else
      this.key[this.keyCheck] = (this.key[this.keyCheck]>0)?-1:0;//-1 = released, 0 = not held

    this.moveKey += (this.keyCheck < 4 && this.key[this.keyCheck] > 0)?1:0;
  }

  this.moveKey = (this.moveKey>0)?1:0;
}

function getIDs(){
  for (this.h = 0; this.h <sarraylen(this.heroes)/4; this.h++){
    for (this.n = 0; this.n <npcscount;this.n++){
      if (npcs[this.n].save[0] == strtofloat(#I(this.heroes,this.h*4+3))){
        this.npcID[this.h] = this.n;
        this.n = npcscount;
      }
    }
  }
}

function getEnemies(){
  for (this.e = 0; this.e <sarraylen(this.enemies)/4; this.e++){
    for (this.n = 0; this.n <npcscount;this.n++){
      if (npcs[this.n].save[0] == strtofloat(#I(this.enemies,this.e*4+3)) && npcs[this.n].hearts > 0){//npc not found or dead
        this.enemyIDs[this.e] = this.n;
        this.n = npcscount;
      }
      else this.enemyIDs[this.e] = -1;
    }
  }
}

function shiftFocus(){
  for (this.n = 0; this.n < npcscount;this.n++)
    callnpc this.n,shiftFocus,#v(this.focus[0]),#v(this.focus[1]),#v(this.focus[2]),#v(this.focus[3]);
  this.focus[0] = this.focus[2];
  this.focus[1] = this.focus[3];
}

function revertControl(){
  this.focus[2] = this.originalFocus[0];
  this.focus[3] = this.originalFocus[1];
  shiftFocus();

  hideimgs 350,400;
  this.menuFocus = 0;
}

function drawPointer(){
  showimg 350,#s(this.pointerImg),npcs[this.enemyIDs[this.targetSel]].x+npcs[this.enemyIDs[this.targetSel]].width/2-0.5,npcs[this.enemyIDs[this.targetSel]].y-1;
}

if (revertControl){//assumed that control's reverted from enemies
  getEnemies();
  enterHeroes();
  revertControl();
}

function enterHeroes(){
  for (this.i = 0; this.i < sarraylen(this.heroes)/4; this.i++){
    callnpc this.npcID[this.i],moveTo,#v((this.i==this.currentHero)?30:27),#v((this.i==this.currentHero)?37:34+this.i*3);
  }
}

if (setAttacks){
  setstring this.items,;
  for (this.i = 0; this.i < strtofloat(#p(0));this.i++)
      addstring this.items,#p(1+this.i);
  drawMenu();
}

NPCEND

// ===== 05_standalone/rpg_project/trpg_battle__001__18_34.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: rpg project/trpg_battle.nw
// npc-index: 1
// header: NPC - 18 34
// image: -
// tile: 18,34
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: a872d15ca1ee

NPC - 18 34
// Graal2002 NPC by Stefan Knorr
if (created) {
  // Initialize the attributes
  showcharacter;
  setcharprop #3,head0.png;
  setcharprop #C0,orange;
  setcharprop #C1,white;
  setcharprop #C2,blue;
  setcharprop #C3,red;
  setcharprop #C4,black;
  setcharprop #2,shield1.gif;
  shieldpower = 1;
  dir = 3;
  hearts = 3;
  this.walkSpeed = 0.4;
  this.attackSpeed = 0.6;
  save[0] = 1;//id
  save[1] = 3;//max life
  setstring this.attacks,
    Payout,tricxta_axe.gif,"A vicious axe based attack.",1,2,0;//name,icon,description,targets,damage,special cost
}

if (getAttacks){
  for (this.i = 0; this.i < npcscount;this.i++){
    callnpc this.i,setAttacks,#v(sarraylen(this.attacks)),#s(this.attacks);
  }
}

if (moveTo){
  this.newX = (strtofloat(#p(0)) >= 0)?strtofloat(#p(0)):x;
  this.newY = (strtofloat(#p(1)) >= 0)?strtofloat(#p(1)):y;
  moveTo();
}

function moveTo(){
  this.dist = ((x-this.newX)^2+(y-this.newY)^2)^0.5;
  this.angle = getangle(this.newX-x,y-this.newY);
  setcharani walk,;
  for (this.i = 0; this.i < this.dist; this.i+=this.walkSpeed){
    x += cos(this.angle)*this.walkSpeed;
    y += sin(this.angle)*this.walkSpeed;
    sleep 0.05;
  }
  setcharani idle,;
}

if (Payout){
  this.damage = strtofloat(#p(2));
  this.npcInd = testnpc(strtofloat(#p(0)),strtofloat(#p(1)));
  this.newX = npcs[this.npcInd].x-npcs[this.npcInd].width;
  this.newY = npcs[this.npcInd].y;
  moveTo();
  setcharani spin,;

  sleep 0.2;
  callnpc this.npcInd,wasHit,#v(this.damage);
  sleep 0.4;

  revertControl();
}

function revertControl(){
  for (this.n = 0; this.n < npcscount; this.n++)
    callnpc this.n,revertControl,;
}

NPCEND

// ===== 05_standalone/rpg_project/trpg_battle__006__16_21.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: rpg project/trpg_battle.nw
// npc-index: 6
// header: NPC - 16 21
// image: -
// tile: 16,21
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: 429f8b8bedd2

NPC - 16 21
// NPC made by tricxta
if (playerenters){
  this.focus = {-1,-1,-1,-1};
  this.transTime = 0.5;
}

if (forceFocus){
  this.focus[2] = strtofloat(#p(0));
  this.focus[3] = strtofloat(#p(1));
}

if (shiftFocus){
  this.focus[0] = strtofloat(#p(0));
  this.focus[1] = strtofloat(#p(1));
  this.focus[2] = strtofloat(#p(2));
  this.focus[3] = strtofloat(#p(3));

  //perform the shift in focus
  this.fX1 = this.focus[0];
  this.fY1 = this.focus[1];
  this.fX2 = this.focus[2];
  this.fY2 = this.focus[3];

  for (this.i=0;this.i<=this.transTime;this.i+=0.05){
    this.fP = (this.i/this.transTime);//focus percentage
    this.focusX = this.focus[0] + (this.focus[2]-this.focus[0])*this.fP;
    this.focusY = this.focus[1] + (this.focus[3]-this.focus[1])*this.fP;
    setfocus this.focusX,this.focusY;

    if (this.focus[2]-this.focus[0]==0 && this.focus[3]-this.focus[1]==0)this.i = this.transTime;//no need to shift focus
    else sleep .05;
  }
}

function showcategory(){
  showimg 302,riley_exoticqmenu01.gif,this.originx+425,this.originy+3+(this.category*31);
  changeimgpart 302,459,3+(this.category*31),32,32;
  changeimgvis 302,5;

function drawweapons(){
  hideimgs 400,400+this.weaponcount;
  this.weaponcount=0;
  setstring this.weaponindexes,;
  for (this.i=0;this.i<weaponscount;this.i++){
    tokenize2 /,#w(this.i);
    if (strcontains(#s(this.category#v(this.category)),#t(0)) && !startswith(-,#w(this.i))){
      setstring this.weaponindexes,#s(this.weaponindexes)#v(this.i),;
      showimg 400+this.weaponcount,#W(this.i),this.originx+164+((this.weaponcount%6)*42),this.originy+23+(int(this.weaponcount/6)*42);
      changeimgvis 400+this.weaponcount,5;
      this.weaponcount++;
    }
  }
}

function typesort(){
  setstring this.tempindexes,#s(this.weaponindexes);
  set moved;
  while (moved){
    tokenize #s(this.tempindexes);
    unset moved;
    for (this.i=0;this.i<tokenscount-1;this.i++){
      tokenize #s(this.tempindexes);
      setstring this.compare1,#w(strtofloat(#t(this.i)));
      setstring this.compare2,#w(strtofloat(#t(this.i+1)));
      if (!strequals(#e(0,3,#s(this.compare1)),#e(0,3,#s(this.compare2)))){
        for (this.a=0;this.a<3;this.a++){
          if (!strequals(#e(this.a,1,#s(this.compare1)),#e(this.a,1,#s(this.compare2))))this.char=this.a;
        }
        if (ascii(#e(this.char,1,#s(this.compare1)))>ascii(#e(this.char,1,#s(this.compare2)))){
          setstring this.tempindexes,;
          for (this.a=0;this.a<this.i;this.a++)setstring this.tempindexes,#s(this.tempindexes)#t(this.a),;
          setstring this.tempindexes,#s(this.tempindexes)#t(this.i+1),;
          setstring this.tempindexes,#s(this.tempindexes)#t(this.i),;
          for (this.a=this.i+2;this.a<tokenscount;this.a++)setstring this.tempindexes,#s(this.tempindexes)#t(this.a),;
          set moved;
        }
      }
    }
  }
  setstring this.weaponindexes,#s(this.tempindexes);
  drawweapons2();
}

function alphasort(){
  setstring this.tempindexes,#s(this.weaponindexes);
  set moved;
  while (moved){
    tokenize #s(this.tempindexes);
    unset moved;
    for (this.i=0;this.i<tokenscount-1;this.i++){
      tokenize #s(this.tempindexes);
      this.index=strtofloat(#t(this.i));
      tokenize2 /,#w(this.index);
      setstring this.compare1,#t(1);
      tokenize #s(this.tempindexes);
      this.index=strtofloat(#t(this.i+1));
      tokenize2 /,#w(this.index);
      setstring this.compare2,#t(1);
      tokenize #s(this.tempindexes);
      if (!strequals(#e(0,3,#s(this.compare1)),#e(0,3,#s(this.compare2)))){
        for (this.a=0;this.a<3;this.a++){
          if (!strequals(#e(this.a,1,#s(this.compare1)),#e(this.a,1,#s(this.compare2))))this.char=this.a;
        }
        if (ascii(#e(this.char,1,#s(this.compare1)))>ascii(#e(this.char,1,#s(this.compare2)))){
          setstring this.tempindexes,;
          for (this.a=0;this.a<this.i;this.a++)setstring this.tempindexes,#s(this.tempindexes)#t(this.a),;
          setstring this.tempindexes,#s(this.tempindexes)#t(this.i+1),;
          setstring this.tempindexes,#s(this.tempindexes)#t(this.i),;
          for (this.a=this.i+2;this.a<tokenscount;this.a++)setstring this.tempindexes,#s(this.tempindexes)#t(this.a),;
          set moved;
        }
      }
    }
  }
  setstring this.weaponindexes,#s(this.tempindexes);
  drawweapons2();
}

function drawweapons2(){
  hideimgs 400,400+this.weaponcount;
  tokenize #s(this.weaponindexes);
  for (this.i=0;this.i<tokenscount;this.i++){
    showimg 400+this.i,#W(strtofloat(#t(this.i))),this.originx+164+((this.i%6)*42),this.originy+23+(int(this.i/6)*42);
    changeimgvis 400+this.i,5;
  }
}

function deleteweapon(){
  if (this.selectweapon>-1){
    showimg 308,riley_exoticrandomgui01.gif,this.originx+126,this.originy+120.5;
    changeimgpart 308,0,0,198,86;
    changeimgvis 308,6;
    showimg 309,riley_exoticrandomgui01.gif,this.originx+164,this.originy+173.5;
    changeimgpart 309,0,96,42,17;
    changeimgvis 309,6;
    showimg 310,riley_exoticrandomgui01.gif,this.originx+244,this.originy+173.5;
    changeimgpart 310,0,119,42,17;
    changeimgvis 310,6;
    showtext 311,this.originx+227,this.originy+150,arial,c,Would you like to delete this?;
    changeimgzoom 311,.5;
    changeimgvis 311,7;
    this.menu2=1;
  }
}

  }
}

// ===== 05_standalone/shadowCasting/lightthing__000__27_21.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: shadowCasting/lightthing.nw
// npc-index: 0
// header: NPC - 27 21
// image: -
// tile: 27,21
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: de6230dec6c7

NPC - 27 21
// NPC made by tricxta
if (playerenters){
  replaceani idle,xialza_lamp_idle;
  replaceani walk,xialza_lamp_walk;
  seteffect 0,0,0.1,0.5;
  timereverywhere;
  noplayerkilling;
  this.quality = 10;

  this.lightRad = 20;//actually is the diameter

  timeout = 0.05;
}

if (timeout){
  setstring this.cRec,;
  //top left
  addstring this.cRec,0;
  addstring this.cRec,0;

  //top centre
  addstring this.cRec,#v(playerx);
  addstring this.cRec,0;

  for (this.degrees = 360; this.degrees >= 0; this.degrees-=this.quality){
    this.radians = (this.degrees/360)*(2*pi) - (pi/2);
    this.lightOnwall = 0;
    for (this.r = 0; this.r < (this.lightRad/2); this.r+= (this.quality/10)){
     if (!lighteffectsenabled)continue;
      this.sampleCoords = {playerx+1.5+cos(this.radians)*this.r,playery+1.5+sin(this.radians)*this.r};
      if (onwall(this.sampleCoords[0],this.sampleCoords[1])){
        this.lightOnwall = 1;
      }
      else if (this.lightOnwall == 1){
        this.r = this.lightRad;
      }
    }
    addstring this.cRec,#v(this.sampleCoords[0]);
    addstring this.cRec,#v(this.sampleCoords[1]);
  }

  //finish the loop
  addstring this.cRec,#I(this.cRec,4);
  addstring this.cRec,#I(this.cRec,5);

  //top centre
  addstring this.cRec,#v(playerx);
  addstring this.cRec,0;

  //top right
  addstring this.cRec,64;
  addstring this.cRec,0;

  //bottom right
  addstring this.cRec,64;
  addstring this.cRec,64;

  //bottom left
  addstring this.cRec,0;
  addstring this.cRec,64;

  setarray this.poly,sarraylen(this.cRec);
  for (this.i = 0; this.i < sarraylen(this.cRec); this.i++)
    this.poly[this.i] = strtofloat(#I(this.cRec,this.i));

  showpoly 300,this.poly;
  changeimgcolors 300,0,0,0,0;

  timeout = 0.05;
}

if (mousewheel){
  this.quality = max(2,min(20,this.quality+mousewheeldelta));
  setplayerprop #c,quality:#v(this.quality);
}

NPCEND

// ===== 05_standalone/side_scroller/ssa_item-menu__000__42_51.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: side scroller/ssa_item-menu.nw
// npc-index: 0
// header: NPC - 42 51
// image: -
// tile: 42,51
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: da27ec6094eb

NPC - 42 51
// NPC made by tricxta
if (playerenters){
  enablefeatures 0x40+0x80+0x200+0x800+0x1000;
  setstring this.img,ssa_item-menu.gif;
  this.keydown = 0;
}

if (keypressed && strtofloat(#p(0)) == 81 && this.keydown==0){
  findWeapons();
  this.keydown = 1;
  this.menu = (this.menu+1)%2;
  if (this.menu == 1)draw();
  else close();
  while (keydown2(81,true))sleep .05;
  this.keydown = 0;
}

if (mousewheel && this.menu == 1 && this.weaponscount > 25){
  this.startIndex += mousewheeldelta*5;
  if (this.startIndex < 0)this.startIndex = 0;
  else if(this.startIndex>this.weaponscount-25)this.startIndex = this.weaponscount-25;
  draw();
}

function draw(){
  this.px = screenwidth/2-137;
  this.py = screenheight/2-120;
  showimg 300,#s(this.img),this.px,this.py;//main menu
  changeimgpart 300,0,0,274,240;

  showimg 301,#s(this.img),this.px+229,this.py+35;//scroll bg
  changeimgpart 301,295,0,24,170;

  this.dist=(this.weaponscount>25)?((this.startIndex/this.weaponscount)*167):0;
  this.height=(this.weaponscount>25)?((25/this.weaponscount)*167):167;
  showimg 302,#s(this.img),this.px+231,this.py+37+this.dist;//scroll bar
  changeimgpart 302,273,1,20,this.height;
  showimg 303,#s(this.img),this.px+231,this.py+34+this.dist+this.height;
  changeimgpart 303,273,165,20,3;

  this.limit = this.weaponscount;
  if (this.limit>25)this.limit = 25;

  for (this.i = 0;this.i<this.limit;this.i++){//weapons disp
    showimg 310+this.i,#W(strtofloat(#I(this.wI,this.i)) + this.startIndex),this.px+20+(this.i%5)*40,this.py+26+int(this.i/5)*40;
  }

  for (this.i=300;this.i<335;this.i++)changeimgvis this.i,(this.i==300)?4:5;
  changeimgvis 302,6;
  changeimgvis 303,7;
}

function findWeapons(){
  this.weaponscount = 0;
  setstring this.wI,;
  for (this.i=0;this.i<weaponscount;this.i++){
    if (!startswith(-,#w(this.i))){
      setstring this.wI,#s(this.wI)#v(this.i),;
      this.weaponscount++;
    }
  }
}

function close(){
  hideimgs 300,335;
}

// ===== 05_standalone/side_scroller/ssa_mutliplayer-lobby__003__19_10.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: side scroller/ssa_mutliplayer-lobby.nw
// npc-index: 3

NPC - 19 10
// NPC made by tricxta
//Cloud generator

if (playerenters){
  if (!isweapon)toweapons -cloudgen;
  seteffect ,,,;
  timereverywhere;
  this.clouds=20;
  setarray this.cloudx,this.clouds;
  setarray this.cloudy,this.clouds;
  setarray this.cloudzoom,this.clouds;
  setarray this.cloudspeed,this.clouds;
  this.toggle=1;
  for (this.i=0;this.i<this.clouds;this.i++)initialize();
  this.toggle=0;
  timeout=0.05;

if (isweapon && timeout){
  for (this.i=0;this.i<this.clouds;this.i++){
    this.cloudx[this.i]+=this.cloudspeed[this.i];
    showimg 300+this.i,ssa_cloud1.png,this.cloudx[this.i]-this.movex,this.cloudy[this.i];
    changeimgvis 300+this.i,3;
    changeimgzoom 300+this.i,this.cloudzoom[this.i];
    changeimgcolors 300+this.i,.1,.1,.1,this.clouda;
    if (this.cloudx[this.i]-this.movex>=30+(screenwidth/2/16))initialize();
  }
  timeout=0.05;
}

function initialize(){
  this.cloudx[this.i]=(this.toggle==1)?random(-15-(screenwidth/2/16),50):(-15-(screenwidth/2/16));
  this.cloudy[this.i]=random(0,30);
  this.cloudzoom[this.i]=random(.1,.3);
  this.cloudspeed[this.i]=random(.3,.7);
  this.clouda[this.i]=random(.4,.6);
}

if (reset){
  this.set=0;
}

// ===== 05_standalone/side_scroller/ssa_mutliplayer-lobby__004__16_13.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: side scroller/ssa_mutliplayer-lobby.nw
// npc-index: 4
// header: NPC - 16 13
// image: -
// tile: 16,13
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: d3c45cb54e4b

NPC - 16 13
//Made by tricxta
if (playerenters){
  addtiledef ssa_game-tiles.gif,ssa_,1;
  if (level.islobby == 1)break;
  if (!isweapon)toweapons -movement;
  disabledefmovement;
  this.player.speed = .75;
  this.player.offsetX = 1.5;
  this.player.offsetY = 3;
  this.player.orgFallSpeed = 1;
  this.player.FallSpeed = this.player.orgFallSpeed;
  this.player.FallAdd = 0.05;
  this.player.maxFallSpeed = 2.5;
  this.player.normalJumpHeight=10;
  this.climbTiles = {0x486,0x487,0x496,0x497};
  this.keysDown = {0,0,0,0,0,0,0};//1 held, else 0

  setstring this.Ganis,idle,walk,ssa_climbidle,ssa_climb;
  timeout=0.05;
}

if (isweapon && timeout){
  if (!movementdisabled){
    this.canClimb = (tiles[playerx+this.player.offsetX,playery+1] in this.climbTiles);

    this.keyPressed = 0;
    this.check = 0;

    for (this.i=0;this.i<4;this.i++){
      if (keydown(this.i)){
        this.key = this.i;
        this.keyPressed = 1;

        if ((this.i+1)%2==0){//horizontal movement
          playerdir = this.i;
          this.gani = 1;
          for (this.j=0;this.j<this.player.speed;this.j+=1/16){
            this.checkX = playerx+1.5+vecx(this.i)*17/16;
            if (onwall(this.checkX,playery+1)){playertouchsme();break;}
            if (onwall(this.checkX,playery+2) && !this.fall==0)break;
            playerx+=vecx(this.i)*1/16;
          }
        }
        else {//vertical movement
          if (this.canClimb == 1){//Climbing the vine
            this.gani = 3;
            this.check = (this.i == 0 && !onwall(playerx+this.player.offsetX,playery) && tiles[playerx+this.player.offsetX,playery] in this.climbTiles);
            this.divis = (this.i==0)?2:1;
            if (this.i == 2 || this.check == 1)playery+= vecy(this.i)*this.player.speed/this.divis;
          }
          else if (this.keysDown[0] == 0){
            this.keysDown[0] = 1;
            triggeraction playerx+this.player.offsetX,playery+2,Interface,#a;//Npc interaction
          }
        }
      }
    }

    //Gani set
    if (this.canClimb == 1)playerdir = 0;

    if (this.keyPressed == 0)this.gani = (this.canClimb == 1)?2:0;

    if (!strequals(#m,#I(this.Ganis,this.gani)))setani #I(this.Ganis,this.gani),;
    //--------------------------------------

    //Jump trigger
    if (keydown(6) && this.jump==0 && onwall(playerx+this.player.offsetX,playery+this.player.offsetY+1/16) && !onwall(playerx+this.player.offsetX,playery) && this.keysDown[6] == 0){
      play jump.wav;
      this.keysDown[6] = 1;
      this.jump=1;
      this.jumpHeight = this.player.normalJumpHeight;
      this.player.FallSpeed = this.player.orgFallSpeed;
    }

    //Key handler
    for (this.i=0;this.i<7;this.i++){
      if (!keydown(this.i))this.keysDown[this.i] = 0;
    }

    checkHeadOnwall();//Check if the head is onwall
    if (this.jump>0 && this.jump<this.jumpHeight && this.how == 0){this.jump++;playery-=(this.jumpHeight-this.jump)*.2;}
    else if (this.jump>0 || this.how>0){
      this.jump=-1;
      if (this.how>0){
        for (this.i=0;this.i<npcscount;this.i++){
          if (playerx+1.5 in |npcs[this.i].x,npcs[this.i].x+npcs[this.i].width| && playery in |npcs[this.i].y,npcs[this.i].y+npcs[this.i].height|)callnpc this.i,playerhitbottom,#v(playerdir);
        }
      }
    }

    if (!onwall(playerx+this.player.offsetX,playery+this.player.offsetY-1/16) && this.jump<=0 && this.canClimb == 0){
      this.i=1/16;
      while (!onwall(playerx+this.player.offsetX,playery+this.player.offsetY+this.i))this.i+=1/16;
      if (this.i<2)playery+=this.i;
      else {
        playery+=this.player.FallSpeed;
        if (this.player.FallSpeed < this.player.maxFallSpeed)this.player.FallSpeed += this.player.FallAdd;
      }
    }
    if (onwall(playerx+this.player.offsetX,playery+this.player.offsetY)){
      this.jump=0;
      for (this.i=0;this.i<npcscount;this.i++){
        if (playerx+1.5 in |npcs[this.i].x,npcs[this.i].x+npcs[this.i].width| && playery+3.5 in |npcs[this.i].y,npcs[this.i].y+npcs[this.i].height|)callnpc this.i,playerontop,#v(playerdir);
      }
      while (onwall(playerx+this.player.offsetX,playery+this.player.offsetY))playery-=1/16;
    }
  }
  timeout=0.05;
}

function checkHeadOnwall(){
  this.how = 0;
  for (this.k=0;this.k<2;this.k++)this.how+=(onwall(playerx+0.5+this.k,playery-.5));
}

function playertouchsme(){
  for (this.i=0;this.i<npcscount;this.i++){
    if (playerx+vecx(playerdir)*2 in |npcs[this.i].x,npcs[this.i].x+npcs[this.i].width|)callnpc this.i,playertouchsme,#v(playerdir);
  }
}

if (actionBounce){
  this.jump = 1;
  play jump.wav;
  this.jumpHeight = strtofloat(#p(0));
  this.player.FallSpeed = this.player.orgFallSpeed;
}

// ===== 05_standalone/side_scroller/ssa_mutliplayer-lobby__011__16_10.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: side scroller/ssa_mutliplayer-lobby.nw
// npc-index: 11
// header: NPC - 16 10
// image: -
// tile: 16,10
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: 3d2f5d30069a

NPC - 16 10
// NPC made by tricxta
if (playerenters){
  enablefeatures 0x40+0x80+0x200+0x800+0x1000;
  this.screenCover = 3/4;//deafult percentage of screen hidden by map vertically
  this.panSpeed = 10;//10 pixels per 0.05 seconds
  setstring this.checkPointImg,ssa_flag.gif;
  if (!isweapon)toweapons -map;
}

if (keypressed && strtofloat(#p(0)) == 77 && this.keyPressed == 0 && isweapon){
  if (level.NoMap == 1 || mapdisabled || level.isLobby)return;
  this.keyPressed = 1;
  this.mapOpen = (this.mapOpen+1)%2;
  this.viewX = 0;
  this.viewY = 0;

  showimg 301,#s(client.mapImage),0,0;

  this.screenZoom = screenheight*this.screenCover/imgheight(#s(client.mapImage));
  this.zoom = this.screenZoom;

  set movementdisabled;
  drawMap();

  if (this.mapOpen == 1)timeout=0.05;
  else close();

  while (keydown2(77,true))sleep .05;
  this.keyPressed = 0;
  if (this.mapOpen == 0)break;
}

if (timeout && this.mapOpen == 1){
  this.zoom += mousewheeldelta*0.1;
  if (this.zoom < this.screenZoom)this.zoom = this.screenZoom;
  if (this.zoom > 1.3)this.zoom = 1.3;//Some weird bug makes it vanish after 1.3
  for (this.i=0;this.i<4;this.i++){
    if (keydown(this.i)){
      this.viewX -= vecx(this.i)*this.panSpeed;
      this.viewY -= vecy(this.i)*this.panSpeed;
    }
  }
  if (this.viewX > 0)this.viewX = 0;
  else if (abs(this.viewX- screenwidth) > imgwidth(#s(client.mapImage))/2)this.viewX = (this.zoom * imgwidth(#s(client.mapImage))/2 - screenwidth)*-1;
  this.max = (imgheight(#s(client.mapImage))*this.zoom-screenheight)/2;

  if (this.zoom * imgheight(#s(client.mapImage)) < screenheight)this.viewY = 0;
  else if (this.viewY > this.max - 10)this.viewY = this.max-10;
  else if (this.viewY < this.max*-1)this.viewY = this.max*-1;
  drawMap();
  timeout=0.05;
}

function drawMap(){
  this.mapPlaceX = 0 - (1-this.zoom)*imgwidth(#s(client.mapImage))/2;
  this.mapPlaceY = screenheight/2 - imgheight(#s(client.mapImage))/2;

  showpoly 300,{0,0,screenwidth,0,screenwidth,screenheight,0,screenheight};//black background
  changeimgcolors 300,0,0,0,0;
  changeimgvis 300,4;

  showimg 301,#s(client.mapImage),this.mapPlaceX+this.viewX,this.mapPlaceY+this.viewY;//map image
  changeimgzoom 301,this.zoom;
  changeimgvis 301,5;

  showtext 302,screenwidth/2,screenheight - 50,verdana,c,Zoom:#e(0,3,#v(this.zoom))%;
  changeimgzoom 302,.8;
  changeimgvis 302,5;

  showimg 303,ssa_map-progress.gif,screenwidth/2-200,20;
  changeimgvis 303,5;

  this.playerProgress = (lindexof(#e(strlen(#L)-5,2,#L),client.mapLevels)*64+playerx)/(sarraylen(client.mapLevels)*64);

  showimg 304,#3,screenwidth/2-200+this.playerProgress*400,23;
  changeimgpart 304,0,96,32,32;
  changeimgvis 304,6;

  for (this.i=0;this.i<sarraylen(client.checkPoints);this.i++){
    showimg 312+this.i,#s(this.checkPointImg),strtofloat(#I(client.checkPoints,this.i*2))*16*this.zoom+this.viewX,screenheight/2+this.viewY+strtofloat(#I(client.checkPoints,this.i*2+1))*16*this.zoom;
    //changeimgzoom 312+this.i,this.zoom;
    changeimgvis 312+this.i,6;
  }
}

function close(){
  hideimgs 300,311+sarraylen(client.checkPoints);
  unset movementdisabled;
}

function getIndex(){
  for (this.i=0;this.i<npcscount;this.i++){
    if (npcs[this.i].x==x && npcs[this.i].y==y){this.index=this.i;break;}
  }
}

function checkweapons(){
  if (!hasweapon(Swords/Relic Sword))callweapon this.i,setWeapons,riley_exoticswordicon1.gif,120,"Relic Sword: A crude and battered sword from times long ago. It must have quite the history.","Swords/Relic Sword";

  if (!hasweapon(Swords/Gladius Sword))callweapon this.i,setWeapons,"riley_exoticswordicon2.gif",200,"Gladius: A common sword for the warrior. Strong steel, and double edged it's ready for battle!","Swords/Gladius Sword";

  if (!hasweapon(Swords/Save The Queen Sword))callweapon this.i,setWeapons,"riley_exoticswordicon5.gif",700,"Save The Queen: A sword that has been passed down through the royal knights for generations.","Swords/Save The Queen Sword";

  if (!hasweapon(Swords/Split Sword))callweapon this.i,setWeapons,"riley_exoticswordicon6.gif",250,"Split Sword: A sword design from a far away kingdom. It can be considered a foreign Gladius.","Swords/Split Sword";

  if (!hasweapon(Swords/Dragons Scale Sword))callweapon this.i,setWeapons,"riley_exoticswordicon7.gif",1000,"Dragon's Scale: A sword made from a single dragon scale crafted over a period of 40 years time.","Swords/Dragons Scale Sword";
}

function close(){
  unset movementdisabled;
  hideimgs 300,301;
  this.menu=0;
  break;
}

function drawitems(){
  this.dist=(this.weaponcount>3)?((this.scroll/this.weaponcount)*167):0;
  this.calc=(this.weaponcount>3)?((3/this.weaponcount)*167):167;
  showimg 301,seeker_shopgui01.gif,this.originx+2,this.originy+this.dist;
  changeimgpart 301,0,0,20,this.calc;
  changeimgvis 301,5;
  showimg 302,seeker_shopgui01.gif,this.originx+2,this.originy+this.dist+this.calc;
  changeimgpart 302,0,169,20,3;
  changeimgvis 302,6;

  hideimgs 304,304+this.imgcount;
  this.imgcount=0;
  for (this.i=0;this.i<((this.weaponcount>3)?3:this.weaponcount);this.i++){
    tokenize #s(this.weapon#v(this.scroll+this.i));
    showimg 304+this.imgcount,#t(0),this.originx+47,this.originy+21+(this.i*53);
    changeimgvis 304+this.imgcount,6;
    this.imgcount++;
    showtext 304+this.imgcount,this.originx+106,this.originy+44+(this.i*53),arial,c,#t(1)c;
    changeimgzoom 304+this.imgcount,.5;
    changeimgvis 304+this.imgcount,6;

      showtext 304+this.imgcount,this.originx+137,this.originy+19+(this.t*10)+(this.i*53),arial,l,#t(this.t);

  }

function buyitem(){
  for (this.i=0;this.i<((this.weaponcount>3)?3:this.weaponcount);this.i++){
    if (mousescreeny in |this.originy+21+(this.i*53),(this.originy+21+(this.i*53))+15|){
      tokenize #s(this.weapon#v(this.scroll+this.i));
      if (playerrupees>=strtofloat(#t(1))){
        triggeraction 0,0,gr.addweapon,#s(this.weapon#v(this.scroll+this.i)weapon);
        playerrupees-=strtofloat(#t(1));
        close();
      }
      else callnpc this.npcindex,reject;
    }
  }
}

// ===== 05_standalone/snow-fall/snowing__000__24_30.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: snow-fall/snowing.nw
// npc-index: 0
// header: NPC - 24 30
// image: -
// tile: 24,30
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: e9b1a68cd13d

NPC - 24 30
// NPC made by tricxta
if (Playerenters){
  this.snow=200;//max amount of snow flakes on the screen at one time
  setstring this.snow_img,g4_particle_snowflake.png;

  this.fall_speed={5,10};//5-10 pixels per .05 seconds
  this.wind={7,8};//min,max wind speed:is random
  this.alpha=.6;//transparency on the snow image


  //Don't touch anything below here!
  //=======================================
  setarray this.speed,this.snow;//falling speed
  setarray this.side,this.snow;//wind
  setarray this.sx,this.snow;//x
  setarray this.sy,this.snow;//y
  for (this.i=0;this.i<this.snow;this.i++)this.speed[this.i]=-1;//used to check for first time

  timeout=0.05;
}

if (timeout){
  for (this.i=0;this.i<this.snow;this.i++){
    if (this.speed[this.i]==-1){
      new();
      this.i=this.snow;
    }
    else {
      this.sx[this.i]+=this.side[this.i];
      this.sy[this.i]+=this.speed[this.i];
      if (this.sx[this.i] >=screenwidth || this.sy[this.i] >=screenheight)new();
      else draw();
    }
  }
  timeout=0.05;
}

function new(){
  if (random(0,100)>50){
    this.sx[this.i]=random(0,screenwidth);
    this.sy[this.i]=0;
  }
  else {
    this.sx[this.i]=0;
    this.sy[this.i]=random(0,screenheight);
  }
  this.speed[this.i]=random(this.fall_speed[0],this.fall_speed[1]);
  this.side[this.i]=random(this.wind[0],this.wind[1]);
  draw();
}

function draw(){
  showimg 300+this.i,#s(this.snow_img),this.sx[this.i],this.sy[this.i];
  changeimgvis 300+this.i,4;
  changeimgmode 300+this.i,1;
  changeimgcolors 300+this.i,1,1,1,this.alpha;
}

// ===== 05_standalone/spike_block/spikeblock__000__27_29.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: spike block/spikeblock.nw
// npc-index: 0
// header: NPC spikeblock1.gif 27 29
// image: spikeblock1.gif
// tile: 27,29
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: cb334e59a531

NPC spikeblock1.gif 27 29
// NPC made by Tricxta
if (playerenters){
  this.ox = 27;//original x
  this.oy = 29;//original y

  //Debug reasons
  snap();

  this.speed = 1;//speed at which the npc moves

  //Don't touch from here on in
  this.dist = 0;
  this.chase = 0;//keeps track of the state of the npc
  this.moved = 0;
  timeout=0.05;
}

if (timeout){
  if ((playerx in |x-2,x+2| || playery in |y-2,y+2|) && this.chase == 0){//look for the player
    this.chase = 1;
    this.pAngle = getangle((playerx-x+1),(playery-y+1));
    this.dir = (int((this.pAngle+(pi*2/8))/(pi*2/4))+3)%4;
  }
  else if (this.chase == 1){//try to attack the player
    if (onwall(x+1+vecx(this.dir)*1.5,y+1+vecy(this.dir)*1.5)){
      this.chase = -1;
      this.dir = (this.dir+2)%4;
      if (this.dist > 0){this.moved = 1;play spikeblockclang.wav;}
    }
    else {
      move();
      this.dist += this.speed;
    }
  }
  else if (this.chase == -1){//retreat
    if (this.dist<=0){
      if (this.moved == 1){play spikeblockclang.wav;this.moved = 0;}
      this.chase = 0;
      snap();
    }
    else {
      move();
      this.dist -= this.speed;
    }
  }
  timeout=0.05;
}

function move(){
  x+=vecx(this.dir)*this.speed;
  y+=vecy(this.dir)*this.speed;
  hitobjects 1,x+1+vecx(this.dir)*2,y+1+vecy(this.dir)*2;
}

function snap(){
  x = this.ox;
  y = this.oy;
}

// ===== 05_standalone/tileanimation/tileanimationsv2__000__33_40.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: tileanimation/tileanimationsv2.nw
// npc-index: 0
// header: NPC - 33 40
// image: -
// tile: 33,40
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: 8edc5269907a

NPC - 33 40
// NPC made by tricxta
if (playerenters){
  timereverywhere;
  setstring this.tileset,pics1.png;//tileset  used to show the animations
  this.speed=.25;//speed at which the tiles cycle
  this.sequence={0x64F,0x65F,0x66F,0x64F};//store cycle tiles
  this.sequencestep={2,2,2};//store sequence lengths
  this.sequencepos={0,1,2};//store tile positions
  this.sequences=3;//number of different sequences
  setarray this.ts,4096;//store all level tile data
  this.count=0;
  for (this.i=0;this.i<4096;this.i++){
    for (this.a=0;this.a<this.sequences;this.a++){//remember to change the count
      if (tiles[this.i%64,int(this.i/64)]==this.sequence[this.sequencepos[this.a]]){
        this.ts[this.count]=this.i%64;
        this.ts[this.count+1]=int(this.i/64);
        this.ts[this.count+2]=this.sequencepos[this.a];
        this.ts[this.count+3]=this.sequencestep[this.a];
        this.count+=4;
      }
      if (this.i%(64*32)==0)sleep .05;
    }
  }
  timeout=0.05;
}

if (timeout){
  this.step++;
  for (this.i=0;this.i<this.count;this.i+=4){
    this.tile=this.sequence[this.ts[this.i+2]+(this.step%this.ts[this.i+3])];
    showimg 300+(this.ts[this.i+1]*64)+this.ts[this.i],#s(this.tileset),this.ts[this.i],this.ts[this.i+1];
    changeimgpart 300+(this.ts[this.i+1]*64)+this.ts[this.i],256*int(this.tile/512)+16*(this.tile%16),int((this.tile%512)/16)*16,16,16;
    changeimgvis 300+(this.ts[this.i+1]*64)+this.ts[this.i],0;
  }
  timeout=this.speed;
}

  this.firerate=2;//more like freeze rate
  this.power=4;
  timeout=0.1;
}

if (start){
  this.set=1;
  this.start=1;
  this.pause=0;
  timeout=0.05;
}

if (pause){
  this.pause=1;
  break;
}

if (timeout){
  if (this.pause==0 && this.start==1){
    if (this.fire==0){
      for (this.i=1;this.i<npcscount;this.i++){
        this.dist=(((npcs[this.i].x-x)^2)+((npcs[this.i].y-y)^2))^.5;
        if (this.dist <=this.radius && !strcontains(#s(this.friends),#f(this.i)) && (npcs[this.i].x in |x-.5,x+.5| || npcs[this.i].y in |y-1,y|)){
          this.angle=getangle(npcs[this.i].x-x+1,npcs[this.i].y-y+1);
          setshootparams #v(this.power);
          getdir();
          shoot x-.5,y-1,0,this.angle,0,0,ttd-wooden-arrow,;
          break;
        }
      }
    }
    this.fire=(this.fire+0.05)%this.firerate;
  }
  if ((strtofloat(#s(client.drag))==1 && this.select==1) || this.placed==0){
    x=int(mousex/2)*2;
    y=int(mousey/2)*2;
    draw();
    if (leftmousebutton){
      checkonwall();
      if (this.onwall==0){setstring client.drag,0;this.select=0;this.placed=1;}
    }
  }
  timeout=0.05;
}

if (drag){
  if (this.set==0){
    this.select=1;
    setstring client.drag,1;
  }
  timeout=0.05;
}

if (getinfo){
  draw();
  timeout=0.05;
}

if (hideinfo){
  hideimgs 300,303;
  timeout=0.05;
}

function draw(){
  showimg 300,ttd_tower-radius.png,x,y;
  changeimgmode 300,1;
  changeimgcolors 300,1,1,1,.5;
  changeimgzoom 300,-1+this.radius;
  showtext 301,x+1,y-3,arial,c,Range:#v(this.radius);
  showtext 302,x+1,y-2,arial,c,Power:#v(this.power);
  showtext 303,x+1,y-1,arial,c,Fire Rate:#v(this.firerate);
}

function checkonwall(){
  this.onwall=0;
  for (this.wall=0;this.wall<4;this.wall++)this.onwall+=onwall(x+(this.wall%2),y+int(this.wall/2));
}

function getdir(){
  this.distx=npcs[this.i].x-x;
  this.disty=npcs[this.i].y-y;
  dir=(abs(this.distx)>abs(this.disty))?2+this.distx/abs(this.distx):1+this.disty/abs(this.disty);
}

// ===== 05_standalone/tower_defense/level1-noob__000__0_0.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: tower defense/level1-noob.txt
// npc-index: 0
// header: NPC - 0 0
// image: -
// tile: 0,0
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: a57631f81a79

NPC - 0 0
//NPC by tricxta
if (playerenters){
  showcharacter;
  setcharprop #3,head0.png;
  setcharprop #C0,orange;
  setcharprop #C1,white;
  setcharprop #C2,blue;
  setcharprop #C3,red;
  setcharprop #C4,black;
  setcharprop #2,shield1.gif;
  shieldpower = 1;
  dir = 0;
  this.pathtiles={0xAA};
  x=int(x)+.5;
  this.loot=3;
  this.speed=.25;
  setcharani walk,;
  this.health=6;
  timeout=0.05;
}

if (start){
  setcharani walk,;
  this.pause=0;
  timeout=0.05;
}

if (pause){
  setcharani idle,;
  this.pause=1;
  break;
}

if (timeout && this.pause==0){
  //this.speed+=(mousewheeldelta*.05);
  if (x>=61)score();
  checktiles();
  if (this.check==4){
    x+=vecx(dir)*this.speed;
    y+=vecy(dir)*this.speed;
  }
  else {
    this.indir=(dir+2)%4;
    dir=int(random(0,4));
    checktiles();
    while (this.indir==dir || this.check<4){dir=int(random(0,4));checktiles();}
  }
  timeout=0.05;
}

function checktiles(){
  this.checkx=x+.5+vecx(dir);
  this.checky=y+1+(vecy(dir)*.5);
  if (dir==2)this.checky+=.5;
  if (dir==1)this.checkx+=.5;
  //showimg 300,block.png,this.checkx,this.checky;
  this.check=0;
  for (this.i=0;this.i<4;this.i++)
    this.check+=tiles[this.checkx+(this.i%2),this.checky+int(this.i/2)] in this.pathtiles;
}

if (actionprojectile && this.health>0){
  this.health-=strtofloat(#p(0));
  if (this.health<=0){
    setcharani dead,;
    sleep 1;
    hide;
    playerrupees+=this.loot;
    level.finish--;
    destroy;
  }
  else timeout=0.05;
}

function score(){
  level.lives--;
  level.finish--;
  destroy;
}

NPCEND

// ===== 05_standalone/tower_defense/random-path__000__38_34.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: tower defense/random-path.nw
// npc-index: 0
// header: NPC - 38 34
// image: -
// tile: 38,34
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: 3dcb6fb7b427

NPC - 38 34
// NPC made by tricxta
if (playerenters){
  this.stage=1;
  this.corners=1;
  this.pcorners=0;
  this.maxstraight=16;//excludes end straight

  this.pathtiles={0xAA};
  this.startx=int(random(10,20))*2;//no odds allowed
  this.starty=62;
  this.endx=62;
  this.endy=int(random(5,15))*2;

  this.checkx=this.startx;
  this.checky=this.starty;
  this.dir=0;

  while (this.pcorners<this.corners){
    this.straight=0;
    this.fcx=this.checkx+(vecx(this.dir)*2);
    this.fcy=this.checky+(vecy(this.dir)*2);
    while (this.straight<this.maxstraight && this.fcx in |0,62| && this.fcy in |0,62| && !tiles[this.fcx,this.fcy]==0xAA){
      Place();
      this.checkx+=vecx(this.dir)*2;
      this.checky+=vecy(this.dir)*2;
      this.straight+=2;
    }
    if (this.straight>0)this.pcorners++;
    this.dir+=((random(0,100)>50)?1:3)%4;
    message #v(this.pcorners);
    sleep .1;
  }
  this.dir=(this.endy<this.checky)?0:2;
  while (this.checky != this.endy){
    this.checky+=vecy(this.dir)*2;
    Place();
  }
  this.dir=(this.endx<this.checkx)?1:3;
  while (this.checkx!= this.endx){
    this.checkx+=vecx(this.dir)*2;
    Place();
  }
}

function Place(){
  for (this.i=0;this.i<4;this.i++)
    tiles[this.checkx+(this.i%2),this.checky+int(this.i/2)]=this.pathtiles[0];
  updateboard this.checkx,this.checky,2,2;
}

function clear(){
  showpoly 300,{0,0,screenwidth,0,screenwidth,screenheight,0,screenheight};
  changeimgcolors 300,0,0,0,;
  showtext 301,screenwidth/2,screenheight/2,arial,c,Stage Cleared!;
  for (this.i=0;this.i<2;this.i++){
    changeimgvis 300+this.i,(this.i==0)?4:5;
    changeimgzoom 300+this.i,(this.i==0)?1:2;
  }
}

function gameover(){
  for (this.i=0;this.i<npcscount;this.i++)callnpc this.i,pause,;
  showpoly 300,{0,0,screenwidth,0,screenwidth,screenheight,0,screenheight};
  changeimgcolors 300,0,0,0,;
  showtext 301,screenwidth/2,screenheight/2,arial,c,Game over;
  for (this.i=0;this.i<2;this.i++){
    changeimgvis 300+this.i,(this.i==0)?4:5;
    changeimgzoom 300+this.i,(this.i==0)?1:2;
  }
}

  showimg 301,ttd_add.png,screenwidth-32,0;
  changeimgvis 301,4;
  this.pause=1;
  showstats;
  this.focusx=30;
  this.focusy=30;
  disabledefmovement;
  setstring this.towerimages,ttd_level1turret.png,ttd_level2turret.png,ttd_level1-arrow-turret.png;
  setstring this.towerscript,level1-cannon-tower,level2-cannon-tower,level1-arrow-tower;

  this.prices={50,70,30};
  timeout=0.05;

  showtext 298,10,10,arial,l,Coins:#v(playerrupees)   Lives:#v(level.lives);
  changeimgvis 298,4;
  for (this.i=0;this.i<4;this.i++){
    if (keydown(this.i)){
      this.focusx+=vecx(this.i)*.5;
      this.focusy+=vecy(this.i)*.5;
    }
  }
  setfocus this.focusx,this.focusy;
  timeout=0.05;
}

if (mousedown){
  this.npc=testnpc(int(mousex),int(mousey));
  if (this.npc>=0){
    if (strtofloat(#s(client.drag))==0 && strequals(#p(0),right))callnpc this.npc,drag,;
    else for (this.i=0;this.i<npcscount;this.i++){
      if (this.i==this.npc)callnpc this.i,getinfo,;
      else callnpc this.i,hideinfo,;
    }
  }
  else for (this.i=0;this.i<npcscount;this.i++)callnpc this.i,hideinfo,;

  if (mousescreenx in |screenwidth-80,screenwidth| && mousescreeny in |screenheight-32,screenheight|)toggle();
  else if (mousescreenx in |screenwidth-32,screenwidth| && mousescreeny in |0,32| && this.towertoggle==0){
    this.pause=0;
    toggle();
    this.towertoggle=1;
    tokenize #s(this.towernames);
    this.towercount=tokenscount;
    for (this.i=0;this.i<tokenscount;this.i++){
      showimg 302+this.i,ttd_menu-tab.png,screenwidth-120,40+(this.i*32);
      changeimgvis 302+this.i,4;
      showtext 302+tokenscount+this.i,screenwidth-5,50+(this.i*32),arial,r,#t(this.i),Price:#v(this.prices[this.i]);
      changeimgvis 302+tokenscount+this.i,5;
      changeimgzoom 302+tokenscount+this.i,.45;
      showimg 302+tokenscount*2+this.i,#I(this.towerimages,this.i),screenwidth-120,40+(this.i*32);
      changeimgvis 302+tokenscount*2+this.i,5;
    }
  }
  else if (this.towertoggle==1 && mousescreenx in |screenwidth-120,screenwidth| && mousescreeny in |40,72+(this.towercount*32)|){
    for (this.i=0;this.i<this.towercount;this.i++){
      if (mousescreeny in |40+(this.i*32),72+(this.i*32)| && playerrupees>=this.prices[this.i]){
        this.towerselect=this.i;
        playerrupees-=this.prices[this.i];
        putnpc #I(this.towerimages,this.towerselect),#I(this.towerscript,this.towerselect).txt,mousex,mousey;
      }
    }
  }
  else {hideimgs 302,305+(this.towercount*2);this.towertoggle=0;}
  timeout=0.05;
}

function toggle(){
  this.pause=(this.pause+1)%2;
  if (this.pause==0){
    showimg 300,ttd_pause.png,screenwidth-80,screenheight-32;
    changeimgvis 300,4;
    setstring this.command,start;
  }
  else {
    showimg 300,ttd_start.png,screenwidth-80,screenheight-32;
    changeimgvis 300,4;
    setstring this.command,pause;
  }
  for (this.i=1;this.i<npcscount;this.i++)callnpc this.i,#s(this.command),;
}

  setcharprop #3,head0.png;
  setcharprop #C0,orange;
  setcharprop #C1,white;
  setcharprop #C2,blue;
  setcharprop #C3,red;
  setcharprop #C4,black;
  setcharprop #2,shield1.gif;
  shieldpower = 1;
  dir = 2;
  setcharani sit,;
  x = int(x)+0.5;

  setstring this.phrases,"You suck","You're aweful", "bite me", "Mish is very beautiful";

  timeout = 0.05;
}

if (timeout){
  if (random(0,100) > 80)
    message #R(#s(this.phrases));
  else
    message ;

  timeout = random(2,6);
}

NPCEND

// ===== 05_standalone/trumpet/trumpet__000__23_31.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: trumpet/trumpet.nw
// npc-index: 0
// header: NPC trumpeticon.png 23 31
// image: trumpeticon.png
// tile: 23,31
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: c509e25fd8aa

NPC trumpeticon.png 23 31
// NPC made by tricxta
if (playerenters){
  if (!isweapon)toweapons trumpet;
  this.trumpet={1,4,-1,3,3,2,-1,-1,5};//-1 note doesnt exist
}

if (weaponfired){
  this.play=(this.play+1)%2;
  if (this.play==1){
    setplayerprop #P2,trumpet0.png;
    setani playtrump,;
  }
  else {
    setani idle,;
    enabledefmovement;
  }
}

if (keypressed && this.play==1){
  if (strtofloat(#p(0))==32){
    this.note=0;
    if (keydown2(65,true))this.note+=8;
    if (keydown2(70,true))this.note+=1;
    if (keydown2(71,true))this.note+=2;
    if (keydown2(72,true))this.note+=4;
    setani playtrump2,;
    play trumpet#v(this.trumpet[this.note]).wav;
    sleep .5;
    setani playtrump,;
  }
}

NPCEND

if (playerenters){
  timereverywhere;
  this.waveSpeed = 0.7;
  this.waves = 0.1;
  showimg 300,#f,x,y;
  this.iHeight = height*16;
  this.iWidth = width*16;
  hide;
  hideimg 300;
}

if ((playerchats && strequals(#c,/warp)) ||timeout){
  this.wave+=this.waveSpeed;
  this.waves += this.waveSpeed/4;

  for (this.i = 0;this.i<this.iHeight;this.i++){
    showimg 300+this.i,#f,x+cos(this.i/this.iHeight*this.waves + this.wave),y+this.i/16;
    changeimgpart 300+this.i,0,this.i,this.iWidth,1;
    changeimgvis 300+this.i,0;
  }

  timeout = 0.05;
}
